# Sugar

Sugar ships four pastel palettes: Taro, soft pastels on dark grey; Cinnamon, earthy browns on cream; Sugarplum, bright tones on white; and Fairyfloss Classic, pastels on purple. Colours are edited with the included interactive palette editor, or by changing the theme stylesheet directly to bake a custom palette.

![Sugar screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chooliu/obsidian-sugar-theme/HEAD/docs/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sugar"
    author: "choo"
    repo:   "chooliu/obsidian-sugar-theme"
    slug:   "sugar"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sugar"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/chooliu/obsidian-sugar-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chooliu/obsidian-sugar-theme/HEAD/docs/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "four pastel palettes: Taro (soft pastels on dark grey), Cinnamon (earthy browns on cream), Sugarplum (bright tones on white), and Fairyfloss Classic (pastels on purple). edit colors with the included interactive palette editor or tweak theme.css to bake your own custom palette!"
}
```
